noEffort.zh: 当前模型未提供推理等级。
noEffort.en: This model offers no reasoning levels.

brandDesc.en: Which brand mark the sidebar shows. "Off" leaves the host's own brand area untouched.

collapseDesc.zh: 把侧栏底栏的设置入口收进账户弹层。
collapseDesc.en: Fold the sidebar footer's settings entry into the account popover. Off hands the footer back to the host entirely: no account row, no mirrored popover entries.

autoPopoverDesc.zh: 鼠标移入即展开账户、模型和权限弹层。
autoPopoverDesc.en: Hover opens the account, model, and permission popovers. Off switches them to click-to-open.

composerDesc.zh: 重绘输入区，可选新会话页、对话内或两者。
composerDesc.en: Which input area the skin restyles: the new-conversation page, the conversation, or both. The hero brand mark and headline are unaffected.

usernameDesc.zh: 显示在新会话欢迎语中；留空则使用宿主解析到的系统用户名。
usernameDesc.en: Shown in the new-conversation greeting. Leave empty to use the system username resolved by the host.

banLocaleDesc.zh: 账户横条彩蛋（点侧栏底栏账户弹层顶部那行用户名）里那页封号界面使用的语言。它是独立设置，不跟随界面语言——那页是 Claude 的原界面，按它本来的语言读才对。
banLocaleDesc.en: The language the account-hold page is written in (click the account row at the top of the sidebar footer's popover). It is its own choice rather than following the interface language: the page reproduces Claude's own screen, so it reads the way Claude wrote it.

unavailable.zh: 设置存储不可用，改动不会被保存。
unavailable.en: The settings store is unavailable, so changes will not be saved.

lead.zh: 由于活动异常，我们已于 {time} 暂停你的账户。你的对话与数据都还在。
lead.en: We put your account on hold on {time} because of unusual activity. Your chats and data are safe.

leadError.zh: 如果你认为这次暂停是误判，可以申请账户复核。
leadError.en: If you think this hold is an error, you can request an account review.

step1Desc.zh: 告诉我们当时发生了什么。
step1Desc.en: Tell us more about what happened.

step2Desc.zh: 团队成员会把你的申请与账户活动放在一起复核。
step2Desc.en: A team member will review your request and account activity together.

step3Title.zh: 我们会把结果邮件给你

exportDesc.zh: 我们会把你的对话、项目和设置打包供你下载。这可能需要一些时间。
exportDesc.en: We’ll package up your conversations, projects, and settings for download. This might take some time to complete.

deleteDesc.zh: 你可以永久删除账户与数据。此操作不可撤销。
deleteDesc.en: You can permanently delete your account and data. This can’t be undone.

qwen3.8-max.zh: 通义旗舰：多模态与综合能力最强。

step-5-preview.zh: 阶跃下一代旗舰预览，百万上下文。

minimax-m3.zh: 编程与 Agent 前沿，百万上下文，原生多模态。
minimax-m3.en: Coding and agentic frontier with 1M context and native multimodality.

grok-4.5.zh: xAI 最强模型，主打编程。
grok-4.5.en: xAI's strongest model, aimed at programming.

doubao-seed-2.1.zh: 字节旗舰系列，分层定位，中文与多模态均衡。

ernie-5.0.zh: 超稀疏 MoE，预训练成本极低，中文知识强。
ernie-5.0.en: Ultra-sparse MoE with very low training cost and strong Chinese knowledge.

mistral-large-3.zh: 宽松许可的开源权重模型，综合能力强。
mistral-large-3.en: Permissively licensed open-weight model with strong overall capability.

brands.note: Which brand mark a row shows. Every id names a vendored lockup in src/assets/icons/combine/ or a provider icon in src/assets/icons/providers/; scripts/build.mjs fails the build on an id that is not there. This is presentation data, kept out of the bundle like the rest of this document, and it is separate from the copy rules above: a vendor's mark and a vendor's description line change for different reasons. `providers` is keyed by the harness provider route id, which is exactly the group id the picker receives (`deepseek-official`, `zai`, `google-vertex`, …) — it is the fallback brand for a group whose models no rule claims. `models` is an ordered, anchored rule list resolved against the model id, exactly like `families` and with the same discipline: first match wins, so a broad rule must sit below the narrow ones and every rule must name its vendor (`step` cannot match `step-3.7-flash` by accident only if no earlier rule already claimed it). A model no rule matches falls back to its provider's brand; a brand with no lockup renders the label without a mark.

models.note: Claude rows draw Claude's own lockup, not the parent Anthropic one: the label names the model line, and a wordmark has to match the word it stands in for — the same reason Grok rows draw Grok's rather than xAI's. Anthropic stays the fallback for the `anthropic` route.
Nano Banana is a Gemini image model with its own identity in the catalog, so it draws its own lockup rather than the Gemini one.
Gemma is Google's open model line, so it draws its own lockup rather than the parent Google one — the same reason Claude and Grok do.
A Gemini row shows the model line's mark; the provider group header above it shows Google's, because providers resolve from `providers` and never from here.
Grok is the model line, xAI the company: a Grok row shows Grok's own mark, while the provider group header above it still shows xAI's, because providers resolve from `providers` and never from here.

lockups.note: Per-brand overrides for the vendored lockup, applied by scripts/fetch-lobe-combines.py. `word` is the word the lockup stands in for inside a model name (it must match how the catalog spells it, which is not always Lobe's TITLE), `mark` and `text` name the Lobe icons the two halves are taken from (so a model line can wear its own mark with its parent's wordmark), and `keep` crops a wordmark to a fraction of its ink width (GLM-V's "-V" is not part of the name).

families.note: Anchored on `deepseek` on purpose: an unanchored /flash$/ would hand this copy to glm-5.3-flash, step-3.7-flash and every other vendor's flash tier.

families.note: Anchored to a separator so the digits start a segment: an unanchored \d+b matches the `95b` inside `a95b` and calls a 2.4T MoE a small dense model.
